known_adaptation.interpretation: Finite known-adaptation replay installs an already available Woodbury template into a previously missing connector menu and generates executable source. Ordinary code with equal content performs the same adaptation. No autonomous numerical discovery or exclusive capability claim.
known_adaptation.scope: The old-menu arm is an installed-capability diagnostic, not the strongest incumbent.

repeated_use.definition: Smallest integer k with k*(direct-complete minus candidate-complete)>extra qualification proxy. Complete per-batch proxy conservatively charges construction again; no persistent numerical cache across program runs.
repeated_use.monetary_scope: Analytic work-proxy threshold only; no revenue annualization, demand extrapolation or measured avoidable cash.
repeated_use.same_means_note: The strong conventional/equal-content route has the same methods and cost proxy; no incremental algorithmic saving over it.
repeated_use.timing_caution: Observed single-host result only; exact rational checks and program overhead can outweigh floating-point work savings.
